## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build` and `pnpm check` pass
- [ ] A check covers the change, where it guards the production build, redaction, storage or the host page
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under `## [Unreleased]`, if users will notice the change
- [ ] Every Markdown file this change makes wrong or incomplete is updated (`docs/en.md`, `ARCHITECTURE.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `ROADMAP.md`, `README.md`)
- [ ] No captured logs, HAR files or real credentials in the diff or the description
